name: Anime megacity
description: Hand-painted anime film backgrounds of dystopian future cities: vast dense megacities seen from far above, cramped streets under hanging signs, cyborg labs full of cables, and one tiny figure against huge architecture.
light: cold night: teal and green glow from countless windows, black sky
blue hour haze over the city, sea and towers fading into mist
overcast grey daylight, wet concrete and pale reflections
molten orange glow from towers against a black-red night
composition: vertiginous view straight down from a rooftop, streets winding between towers to the horizon
a narrow street in low-angle perspective, signs overhead, a pale skyscraper at the end
a huge aerial panorama: endless city, a bay, a cluster of towers on the horizon
a lone small figure on a ledge or bridge, the city filling the frame behind
camera_or_medium: hand-painted cel animation background, gouache and airbrush, crisp linework on buildings
texture_detail: thousands of tiny lit windows, fine painted architectural detail, soft glow halos, subtle film grain
subjects: a city seen straight down from a rooftop at night
a crowded old street of hanging signs below a glass tower
an endless megacity around a bay at blue hour
a lone figure on a highway bridge before glowing towers
